beats.say: Why do golf balls have dimples?
Hard wooden, round balls were used for golf from the 14th through the 17th centuries.
In 1848, the Rev. Dr. Robert Adams Paterson invented the gutta-percha ball.
David Stanley Froy, James McHardy, and Peter G. Fernie received a patent in 1897 for a ball with indentations.
Coburn Haskell of Cleveland, Ohio, invented the rubber Haskell golf ball in 1898.
